meta: Small household businesses often keep messy records and add everything up at month's end. AI sorts income and expenses, writes spreadsheet formulas, and explains tax terms.

muc.title: Messy income and expense records
muc.text: Small household businesses often keep messy income and expense notes, and adding it all up at the end of the month is a headache.

muc.title: Let AI sort income and expenses
muc.text: Take a photo or paste the list of income and expenses, and ask AI to sort them into groups like stock purchases, electricity, wages and sales, then total each group.

muc.title: Write spreadsheet formulas
muc.text: Not good with spreadsheets? Just describe what you want in words, and AI writes the formula to work out profit and loss, or highlights in red the days you spent more than you earned.

muc.title: Ask an expert about tax
muc.text: For taxes, the rules change often, so use AI only to understand the concepts, and ask an accountant or the tax office for the actual numbers.

muc.title: Check this week
muc.text: Paste this week's income and expenses into a chatbot, ask it to group and total them, then compare with your own book to see if anything is off.
